line: Praise a child's effort, not just their result.
paragraph: A boy sits at a kitchen table with a sheet of fractions. He has erased the same problem four times; the paper wears a gray smudge. His mother sets down a glass of milk and leans over his shoulder. She points to the scribbled work and says she likes how he kept the columns straight. He looks up, surprised, and picks up his pencil again.
